entities.summary: David Benoit Michineau is a French professional basketball player who last played for AS Monaco of the French LNB Pro A and the EuroLeague. He was drafted by the New Orleans Pelicans in the 2016 NBA draft, with his rights being traded to the Los Angeles Clippers not too long afterwards.
